findings.explanation: Your payments are conditional upon the Client receiving funds from third-party wireless carriers, which ties your compensation to an event outside your control and exposes you to carrier payment delays or defaults.
findings.suggested_change: All payments hereunder shall be payable to IMNTV in United States Dollars on a quarterly basis within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are well. I am looking forward to working together and have one quick request regarding the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the current terms make compensation dependent on third-party carrier payments, which is outside my control. I propose we update this to ensure a predictable schedule, changing it to: All payments hereunder shall be payable to IMNTV in United States Dollars on a quarterly basis within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter. Thank you for your time and flexibility. Best regards,
